What would help next?

Reviewing even 15–30 high-impact cases is useful. The next development pass can incorporate those labels as regression tests. You are not expected to approve all 560 readings by hand.

Source data: v0.8 BIP39 lexicon reconciled against Open English WordNet, VerbNet and Simple English Wiktionary. The present comparisons are generated automatically and are not a gold-standard corpus.

Experimental research tool · v0.9 · Source list verified by BIP39 checksum · No external requests, no account, no server · Results depend on v0.8 grammar limits. Third-party lexical-source evidence is used as candidate metadata, not automatically adopted as grammatical truth.
